assumptions.benchmark: Mirage VSP 3x3-6x6 split and reference evaluator, not the paper's 8x8-32x32 FrozenLake
assumptions.backbone: Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct, matching the LIVR baseline, not the paper's 7B
assumptions.helper: value-function heatmap from map_desc (App. E.1 code), one flat colour per cell at 320x320
assumptions.latent_layout: one block: assistant header (no newline), BOT, K slots, EOT, answer
assumptions.special_tokens: BOT/EOT rows copied from vision start/end; slot and query rows N(0, initializer_range)
assumptions.latent_definition: z is the final-norm hidden state at the K query positions
assumptions.pooling: one pre-norm cross-attention block plus d->d MLP over [helper tokens; queries]
assumptions.vision_tower: the VLM's own vision tower stays frozen in every phase, as for LIVR
assumptions.latent_loss: sum over d, mean over K, as written in eq. 2
assumptions.epochs: paper's 3 epochs and batch 32 per Stage 1 phase, applied to 1,000 rows
assumptions.rl_schedule: cosine with 5% warmup; prompts per step and step count are not in the paper
assumptions.rollouts: temperature-only policy sampling; one update per rollout batch (GRPO default)
assumptions.kl: exact per-token KL over the vocabulary against the frozen Stage 1 model
assumptions.suppression: slot/query/EOT tokens never sampled; BOT blocked after the single block
assumptions.rl_data: RL prompts are the same 1,000 training rows
assumptions.inference: delta sampled from the learned Gaussian at evaluation (paper §4)
